name: ankand-marketplace
description: Real-time auctions and instant-offer marketplace monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace backend && npm run check --workspace frontend
